technology_name: Biopesticide Innovation for Sustainable Teak Protection: HpNPV Formulation
problem_solved: Severe timber productivity and economic losses (up to ₹75,000 per hectare annually) in valuable teak plantations caused by the defoliator pest Hyblaea puera.
description: An eco-friendly, biological pest control solution utilizing the host-specific Hyblaea puera Nucleopolyhedrovirus (HpNPV) which selectively destroys the targeted pest without impacting non-target or beneficial species. The virus attacks the third-instar larvae, inducing high mortality rates within three days. KFRI pioneered the extraction of virus-laden polyhedral inclusion bodies (PIBs) from mass-produced infected larvae to develop refined, freeze-dried wettable powder formulations optimized for field-spraying.
applications:
• Large-scale integrated pest management (IPM) protocols for state forestry corporations

• Commercial biopesticide and biological control agent manufacturing pipelines

• Forestry protection management systems and predictive pest outbreak modeling service provisions

• Private commercial teak plantation maintenance contracts
